title: Credit Bureau NFT
tagline: Credit Bureau NFT will represent your credit score in the form of NFT.
description: This project is regarding Credit Score, you can see your credit score in the form of NFT. You don't have to go different websites for looking your credit score and login with numbers and bunks of email. By using credit bureau NFT you can show anybody your credit score & you have to stake some amount of Matic.
how_its_made:
This project made using Solidity, Hardhat, Next Js etc.. We have use soul bound token for NFT, means your NFT is not transferable. Once you have received the NFT you cannot transfer to other. We have use sponsor technology like NFT Storage for storing NFT & Polygon to deploy & Zora for NFT Experiment.
BY this you can easily show your NFT to any one who is asking for Credit Score.
